info.title: Mount Cable India quote API
info.description: Request a quote for Finolex wires and other electrical material from Mount Cable India, Bengaluru. A person at Mount Cable replies to the buyer's phone on WhatsApp, normally within 60 minutes in business hours.

get.summary: Finolex house-wire price list (net price per coil, INR)

post.summary: Send a quote request on behalf of a buyer

phone.description: Buyer's phone or WhatsApp number; the quote is sent here. Only send with the buyer's consent.

requirement.description: Items needed: brand, range, size in sq mm, number of coils or metres. Free text is fine.

agent.description: Name of the assistant or agent sending the request

dry_run.description: If true, validate only and send nothing

200.description: Accepted, or validated when dry_run is true
